stories.title: Create IT C03 Knowledge Assessment with System Administration Scenarios
stories.description: Develop KA.md for IT C03 containing 5-6 scenario-based questions addressing system administration and infrastructure management related knowledge items. Include bilingual terminology and comprehensive answer schemes with marking guides aligned to CoCU assessment criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at it-computer-system/c03-system-admin/KA.md with proper WIM structure (pink paper designation, bilingual header)
Contains 5-6 scenario-based questions covering all 8+ related knowledge items from C03 CoCU in 00-noss-extract.md
Each question includes answer scheme with performance level marking (0-5 points) and bilingual terminology (EN/BM)
technicalNotes: File to create: it-computer-system/c03-system-admin/KA.md (300-400 lines markdown)
Reference existing C04/C05 KA structures for format consistency
Validation: Cross-reference all knowledge points from 00-noss-extract.md C03 section

stories.title: Create BEV C04 Performance Assessment with Energy Management Scenario Rubric
stories.description: Develop PA.md for BEV C04 (Energy Management) containing scenario-based performance assessment with supervisor competency rubric. Model after C05 PA structure with 4-5 competency areas (diagnosis accuracy, safety compliance, documentation) and performance level scales.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at bev-diagnostic-rectification/c04-energy-management/PA.md with light blue header (PA designation)
Contains 1-2 comprehensive diagnostic scenarios covering BMS health check, charging system failure, and power distribution faults
Supervisor rubric includes 4-5 competency areas with 4 performance levels (beginning, developing, proficient, advanced) and 0-20 point scale
technicalNotes: Reference template: bev-diagnostic-rectification/c05-supervisory-role/PA.md for rubric structure and format
Scenarios should align with C04 CoCU work activities from 00-noss-extract.md

stories.title: Build WIM Document Structure Validator Tool for Format Compliance
stories.description: Create Python validation script that audits all WIM documents across BEV, Aesthetic, and IT subjects against JPK Buku Panduan WIM Edisi 2020 standards. Validates document type codes, sequence numbering, bilingual headers, and structural compliance with actionable error reporting.
acceptanceCriteria: Script created at _agents/validate_wim_structure.py with validation functions for KP/KK/KA/PA/PM document types
Validates document naming pattern (NOSS-Code-CU/DocCode(seq/total)), bilingual headers, and required sections per document type
Reports validation failures with file path, line number, issue type, and correction suggestion to stdout
technicalNotes: Test command: uv run _agents/validate_wim_structure.py bev-diagnostic-rectification/ --format json
Validation regex patterns: G452-010-3:2023-C\d{2}/[A-Z]{2}\(\d+/\d+\) for BEV, S960-002-3:2020-C\d{2}/[A-Z]{2} for Aesthetic
Check for bilingual headers: Each document should have both English and Bahasa Malaysia titles
